headline: The boredom map: every second of every bot run now has a temperature
lede: Runs that go flat are invisible until someone watches a replay. The new map replays the nightly bot policy over three seeds per contract game, scores each second dead/flat/live/spike, and paints worst-first heat strips on the Forge board — then files the worst stretch as QA. Its first honest catch is already on the board: Gauntlet's four-second frozen opening.

notes.text: BOREDOM MAP shipped (#1131): 34 games × 3 seeds replayed through the contract, per-second reward/damage/motion strips on /forge, worst-first. Boredom score = (dead + flat/2)/seconds.

Verified-prod caught a deployment bug older than the map itself: /retrogames/forge/* was swallowed by the SPA catch-all and answered index.html — meaning last session's juice-audit section had never actually rendered in prod. Fixed with a rewrite (#1188) plus a new rewritecheck that refuses to let any public dir lack one.

20 games read 'stone dead' on the first pass — all blind: their contract state hides positions (#1184). They're flagged ∅ on the board and never file until calibrated. MomentumRunner already fixed: it exposed no runner, read 81% bored; honest score is 0%.
New QA filing straight from the map: gauntlet starts with 4 dead seconds, hero frozen, all seeds agree (#1190).

look.text: Gauntlet: check the first 4 seconds yourself against the map's claim
